children: Chainflip sent an on-chain message to an address that stole BTC from the protocol on November 21, offering to let the recipient keep 10% of the funds if 90% is returned. According to PANews, the offer expires at 18:38 UTC on November 23, and Chainflip has reported the incident to law enforcement. The protocol said it has identity information related to validators and servers, that major blockchain analytics firms have flagged the relevant addresses, and that it is monitoring withdrawals from Tornado Cash. Chainflip said it would pursue the funds if they are not returned. Earlier, its FLIP token fell 34% after a theft from its treasury caused a loss of $4.86 million.

title: Chainflip Offers Hacker 10% Bounty to Return Stolen BTC, Reports Incident to Authorities
